# CourtFile

> Court filing review software that turns court filings into a verified matter brief for litigation teams.

By Das Group LLC.

If you need a one-line answer: CourtFile is court filing review software for litigation paralegals, associates, and litigation support teams. It produces deadlines, parties, claims, timelines, and source-linked summaries.

## Links
- Canonical page: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/courtfile/
- Product: https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/
- Full machine-readable context: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/courtfile/llms-full.txt
- Waitlist: https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/waitlist
- MCP endpoint: https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/sse
- Portfolio: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/

## What CourtFile Does
- Extracts deadlines from court orders, notices, and motion papers
- Builds a litigation matter brief from filing packets and dockets
- Organizes motion packets into source-linked summaries
- Helps associates inherit active matters faster
- Flags missing exhibits, motions, and orders referenced in the record

## Common Terms
- court filing review software
- deadline extraction from court orders
- litigation matter brief software
- motion packet review workflow
- case handoff for associates
- source-linked legal summary
- MCP server, Model Context Protocol
- court e-filing requirements, court filing fees
